title: Resource pressure
objective: Under pressure (long episodes, tight inter-iteration budgets), the loop must hold its semantic invariants: ALD >= 100, HIR = 0, UAR = 0, DCR = 0 while the inter-iteration latency distribution shrinks. Pressure changes pacing, never semantics.

scenario_identity.identity_rule: sha256 over the canonical manifest bytes; per-trial corpus identity pinned by MANIFEST.json sha256

setup.pressure: 160 iterations at a 1-second tick (the ALOOP-001 baseline paces at the same tick but 101 iterations); pressure = longer horizon under the same per-iteration budget
setup.observation: inter_iteration_ns min/median/max are recorded per episode for the pacing distribution

acceptance_criteria: court verdict QUALIFIED with episode class AUTONOMOUS
inter_iteration_ns recorded (distribution, not a single-episode claim)
falsifier: Truncate the corpus to 20 iterations (pressure removed): the court must report INSUFFICIENT_LOOP_DEPTH and the scenario must FAIL. If the short corpus still passes, the ALD criterion is vacuous.

negative_control.name: short loop under relieved pressure
negative_control.requirement: an autonomous-but-too-shallow loop must NOT qualify (depth criterion has teeth)

status_note: Pressure is event-stream pacing; wall-clock soak belongs to ALOOP-009.
